jobs.description:
Undelucram.ro on behalf of:
Capgemini Romania
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
Your Role
As a Functional QA Engineer / Tester with Capgemini, you will help ensure the quality of the Interoperable Europe Portal by preparing and executing functional test scenarios for monthly releases, documenting evidence, logging defects, supporting user acceptance testing, and contributing to release demonstrations and periodic testing reports.
In this role you will:
Analyse requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, improvements, and defect fixes to determine test coverage.
Author, review, update, and maintain functional test scenarios in Jira or the agreed test-management tool.
Execute the required functional and regression scenarios for each Portal release, contributing to a recurring suite of approximately 60 scenarios per month.
Support validation of one planned major monthly release and additional minor or urgent releases when required.
Record test evidence, results, status, and traceability accurately for each release.
Log clear, reproducible defects in Jira, including steps, expected and actual results, severity, evidence, and environment details.
Retest corrected defects and perform targeted regression testing before closure.
Collaborate closely with the technical team, QA Lead, business stakeholders, and specialist testers.
Support the identification and coordination of users for relevant user acceptance testing activities.
Contribute to demonstrations of completed features and to quarterly reports covering tests, defects, risks, results, and release status.
Your Profile
Professional experience in manual and functional testing of web applications, portals, or digital services.
Strong knowledge of test-case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management.
Hands-on experience with Jira or a comparable test and defect management tool.
Ability to interpret requirements and acceptance criteria and convert them into effective test scenarios.
Experience creating clear test evidence and high-quality defect reports.
Understanding of web technologies, browser behavior, APIs, and integration testing fundamentals.
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-focused quality mindset.
Ability to manage recurring release deadlines and multiple test cycles.
Strong collaboration skills and confidence working with technical and business stakeholders.
Clear professional English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have
Experience testing Drupal-based platforms or complex content-management systems.
Knowledge of WCAG 2.2 accessibility testing and web usability principles.
Exposure to API testing, SPARQL endpoints, performance testing, or test automation.
Experience supporting UAT, release demonstrations, or European public-sector projects.
What You Will Love About Working Here
Community & Support: Join an active network of quality engineers and testers who share best practices, automation techniques, and insights on Agile and DevOps.
Learning & Development: Benefit from a dedicated Testing Curriculum, personalized digital learning paths, and certification programs to deepen your technical expertise, and your leadership
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from hybrid working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Ingénieure / Ingénieur QA senior - automatisation de tests
QA Engineer (Automation)
jobs.description:
WHY SPEKTR
At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.
Compliance, built like product.
Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.
We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.
It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.
$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.
THE OPPORTUNITY
We’re looking for a
QA Automation Engineer
to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.
What You Will Be Doing
Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.
Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.
API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.
Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.
Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.
What We Are Looking For
The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.
Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.
API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.
Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.
Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.
Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.
Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.
OUR TECH INTERESTS
Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript
Testing: Playwright
AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks
Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines
OUR PROCESS
Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (60 minutes)
How To Apply
We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.
spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

jobs.description:
Who We Are
Our client is looking for a Software Tester / QA Engineer ideally performing also automated testing.
As a Software Tester / QA Engineer, you will support our development team in quality assurance and the further development of the KIDICAP application in the public-sector environment. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and the customer to ensure that new and existing functionalities are implemented reliably and to a high quality standard.
What You’ll Be Doing
Analyzing functional and technical requirements and deriving suitable test scenarios and test cases
Planning, creating, executing, and documenting software tests
Performing functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Testing new functionalities, enhancements, and bug fixes
Quality assurance of frontend, backend, and interface functionalities
Testing legal and functional changes within the KIDICAP application
Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects
Re-testing fixed defects and performing regression tests
Supporting the creation and further development of automated tests
Maintaining and enhancing existing test cases and test documentation
Analyzing and documenting test results
Close collaboration with developers on defect analysis and resolution
Supporting release and acceptance tests
Actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our QA and testing processes
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
At least 5 years of experience in software testing / quality assurance
Experience in creating and executing manual and, ideally, automated tests
Good knowledge of functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Experience with test and defect management
Knowledge of Tosca or comparable test automation tools is an advantage
Experience with Jira or comparable tools
Basic knowledge of REST APIs / interface testing
SQL or database knowledge is an advantage
Experience in an agile development environment
Analytical and structured working style as well as a strong quality mindset
Strong communication skills and enjoyment of collaboration in international and distributed teams

jobs.title: QA Functional Testing Lead- Specialist- Technology
jobs.description:
Job Description
Why This Role Matters
Publicis Sapient is looking for an experienced
Murex CTRM Test Lead
to lead end-to-end test management for a complex SaaS transformation covering both physical and financial trading across precious metals, base metals, energy, FX, interest rates, and cash.
In this hands-on leadership role, you ll take ownership of the overall testing strategy and quality assurance approach across the Murex CTRM platform, connected applications, interfaces, data migration, and critical front-to-back business processes.
You ll work closely with business users, QA teams, technology teams, and Murex stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage across the full trade lifecycle, from pricing and trade capture through risk, operations, treasury, accounting, and reporting. You ll also play a key role in defect management, quality-risk assessment, and go-live readiness.
You ll thrive in this role if you combine strong knowledge of physical and financial trading with hands-on experience leading testing across large-scale Murex or similarly complex trading transformation programmes.
This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who would like to join an international global organization with a start-up mentality. We highly value Openness, Collaboration, Learning Mindset and partner with our clients to drive positive outcomes.
Where You ll Make an Impact
Define, own, and drive the integrated test strategy, test plans, governance, entry and exit criteria, traceability, and quality reporting.
Lead functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and business acceptance testing.
Ensure comprehensive test coverage across the full trade lifecycle, including:
Pricing and trade capture
Real-time position management and P&L
Trade events and lifecycle processing
Market and credit risk
Back-office and operational processes
Treasury, accounting, and reporting
Coordinate testing across Murex and associated inbound and outbound interfaces.
Manage test environments, test data, system dependencies, resources, and release-aligned execution cycles.
Lead defect triage, prioritisation, resolution tracking, and quality-risk assessment.
Coordinate testing activities across business users, QA teams, technology teams, and Murex stakeholders.
Establish an effective testing approach across integrated systems and business processes.
Provide clear visibility into testing progress, quality risks, defects, and readiness to senior stakeholders.
Support go-live readiness assessments and quality-based release decisions.
What You Ll Bring To The Team
Proven experience as a Test Lead or Test Manager within Murex, CTRM, trading platforms, or similarly complex transformation programmes.
Strong functional understanding of physical and financial trading.
Solid knowledge of front-to-back trading processes across Front Office, risk, operations, treasury, accounting, and reporting.
Strong understanding of the complete trade lifecycle, including pricing, trade capture, position management, P&L, trade events, risk, settlement, and reporting.
Demonstrated experience defining and implementing end-to-end test strategies for complex, business-critical platforms.
Strong experience across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and business acceptance testing.
Proven ability to lead test governance, defect management, quality reporting, and risk assessment.
Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.
Strong communication skills, including experience providing clear quality and readiness reporting to senior and executive stakeholders.
Ability to operate effectively in complex transformation environments involving multiple systems, teams, dependencies, and releases.
Additional Experience We Value
Experience with Murex implementations, upgrades, migrations, or SaaS transformation programmes.
Experience testing complex integrated landscapes involving SaaS platforms, legacy applications, APIs and interfaces, market venues, and reporting solutions.
Experience validating complex data migration and reconciliation activities.
Exposure to Commodities Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) environments across precious metals, base metals, and energy.
Experience working with FX, interest rates, cash products, and other financial instruments.
Knowledge of testing approaches for real-time positions, P&L, market risk, and credit risk.
Experience coordinating business acceptance testing across multiple business functions and geographies.
Experience managing testing dependencies across third-party platforms and inbound/outbound interfaces.
Strong understanding of release management and go-live readiness within large-scale trading or financial services transformation programmes
Additional Information
What You’ll Get in Return
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
Many others perks
Company Description
About Publicis Sapient
Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms
and
bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It is where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us.
Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring
We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That is why we are committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams.
If there is anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We are happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com
Your Safety Matters To Us
At Publicis Sapient, we are committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. In some cases, we may partner with trusted, vetted recruitment agencies who will clearly identify themselves as working on behalf of Publicis Sapient. If you receive communication from any other domain claiming to represent us, please treat it with caution and contact us at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Description
Life at Ness
At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a job—it’s a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter.
The Role
We are seeking an inquisitive and talented Test Engineer to join our existing development team working on a new royalty calculation application.
You will be responsible for designing and executing tests and step definitions in accordance with the requirements. You will be expected continuously contribute to the overall test strategy with ideas of tools and technologies.
You will be highly involved in team participation, working closely with your SCRUM team to complete sprint work in the given timeframe.
Key Responsibilities
Test planning and execution: create, enhance and maintain effective and test plan, ensuring adequate depth and breadth of test coverage
Integrate test automation into the earliest stages of the development lifecycle, designing and executing automated scripts alongside feature design and code creation
Integrate AI tools into the testing lifecycle to identify patterns, predict defects, and optimise test coverage.
Communicate risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies to appropriate stakeholders
Understand the requirements from technical and business specifications
Actively support Agile development methods and best practices
Using JIRA to track defects and tasks
Work closely with QA leads and developers
Take part in meetings, provide estimates, assist in presenting issues and solutions
Collaborate with other Development Team members in planning phase of User Stories during Scrum Sprints, and with the QA team in areas such as training and assistance
Support business test team in UAT
Qualifications And Skills
5+ years of comprehensive Software Testing experience across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), with a strong preference for Agile or iterative methodologies.
Deep understanding of REST architecture principles and extensive hands-on experience with tools like Postman and Open API for API design, documentation, and validation.
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining web UI automated tests using modern frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium.
Strong proficiency in writing automated API tests.
Strong understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS) and the ability to write SQL queries for data verification and test setup.
Proven experience in end-to-end test planning, execution, and ongoing test scenario maintenance.
A proactive self-starter with exceptional self-management abilities and a proven track record of performing effectively under pressure.
Deep understanding of core software testing principles, concepts, and methodologies.
Proficiency in risk identification, analysis, and the application of risk-based testing strategies.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly.
Exceptional problem-solving acumen and meticulous attention to detail in all aspects of testing.
Nice to Have
Music industry business knowledge is desirable.
Exposure to testing event-driven systems and validating data streams using Apache Kafka.
Familiarity with leveraging AI tools and assistants to accelerate test generation, optimise test suites, or improve overall QA efficiency.
Experience with non-functional testing tools such as JMeter or K6 to conduct load and performance benchmarks.
A good working knowledge of Typescript.
Why Join Us
At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement, we’d love to connect with you if this role excites you. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team member’s unique talents.
With flexible remote options, diverse projects, and access to development resources, joining Ness means building a career that’s meaningful and impactful.
What To Expect Next
We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":
HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.
Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.
Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.
Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.
While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.
Ready to Start Your Journey?
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
